proposals.evidence: Turner hiṇḍate supplies Nepali hĩṛnu walk, Oriya hiṇḍibā wander and Hindi/Gujarati/Marathi hĩḍ- walk. The Nepalese short forms and Oriya/Bhatri l-pasts are qualified regional reflexes of that family; nasalization, initial h-loss and retroflex variation are preserved. Negative and auxiliary-bearing responses are excluded.
